test_insert_timedelta: test the TimedeltaIndex.insert method to insert a timedelta value at a specified position
test_insert_preserves_freq: test that TimedeltaIndex.insert preserves the frequency attribute when inserting at valid positions
test_insert_coerces_to_object: test that inserting a non-timedelta value into a TimedeltaIndex coerces the result to an object Index
test_insert_nat_values: test that TimedeltaIndex.insert correctly handles various null/NaT values including None, np.nan, pd.NaT, and pd.NA
test_insert_mismatched_types: test that inserting mismatched numeric or datetime types into a TimedeltaIndex converts the result to an object Index
